steps.text: Kawalerielki has entered a state of emergency, confirmed.
Correct signal code, confirmed. Correct squad identification code, confirmed.
Heed my orders.
Remove your disguises, and enter the city.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: It'll still be some time until the power is completely restored.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The Rhodes Islanders have returned to their rooms, as advised. If you two would like to review...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I want to go see them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everything happened so quickly, I'm sure there are many operators who still don't quite understand the situation. With all the anti-Infected protests going on, there's been a lot of pressure on everyone.

options: I'll be counting on you again then, Amiya.
Are you sure you don't need my help?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, it's fine, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know how busy you've been with business negotiations and social events recently. To be honest, I feel bad about it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You should get some rest while you still can.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ahaha, you must already be worn out, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, you've been dealing with those businesspeople nonstop since yesterday. Of course you'd lose your voice, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's okay, with Hibiscus here, I'm sure we won't have any trouble.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just want to go around and see how everyone's doing. I'll be right back.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: There's no need to worry, Amiya. I'll take real good care of the Doctor while you're gone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh... Okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: See you later then.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: ...{@nickname}Doctor.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: There've been some developments in the General Chamber of Commerce that may be disadvantageous to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Coupled with the ongoing power outage, I'm afraid that what happens next will be nothing less than an open conspiracy.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: For the time being... do not leave my side, whatever you do. Of course, it'd be even better if you decided to stay with me of your own accord.

options: Want to take a look around?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Heehee, I didn't expect you to be so forward. Caught me off guard.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Did something good happen?

options: Miss Gravel, what do you think of the K.G.C.C.?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Didn't you ask me something like this before? Or, do you just love the sound of my voice that much?

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: They're parasites on Kazimierz.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: The business class bands together, corrupting the knights and the city, just to chase their ambitions.

options: The General Chamber of Commerce, as its name implies, is just a 'general' assemblage.
There is little that binds them beyond common interest, and they can be divided.
It feels like they're acting as a unit because they're fighting against the knights.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: What did you do?

options: There are roughly four types of executive directors in the K.G.C.C.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Heh... Care to tell me more?

options: One is committed, so radical as to eliminate the knight class.
One is old-fashioned, a rock-solid faction that moves forward step by step.
Another has no principles, just a group of opportunists flocking to potential profit.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: And the last one?

options: The type that Rhodes Island is not ready to contact yet.
Rushing to contact them will only hurt us.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: So what you're saying is there are cracks in the K.G.C.C.? And you... have already taken stock of them?

options: More like it was never possible for them to 'unite' in the first place.
Live for the sake of profit, die for the sake of profit.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: But this is only your first time here, and you were only able to get to know a portion of the executives through your ties with a spokesman.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: How can you be so sure of yourself? The moment you place your trust in the wrong person, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi will no longer bear the consequences.

options: Rhodes Island has never relied on the sacrifices of others to advance its goals.
As if I'd approach those banquets if I wasn't ready to sacrifice something.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gravel
steps.text: Of course not.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Do you still have time to waste?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: About the bounty placed on the Infected, once the interference from the Great Separation has passed, you'll have no escape route.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Ah, by the way, the reason it's called the 'Great Separation' is because after power from the core is lost, each plate will experience a short period of drift.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Right now, the connections to the plates around the K.G.C.C. have broken off, and you won't be able to escape.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Ugh... Goddammit...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This doesn't seem like an enemy we can take head-on.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm glad you finally understand what you should've always understood. So let me ask again, will you hand me the goods? I wouldn't mind letting you go.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Heh, when is the Armorless Union a charity?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I guess it was a matter of mindset. After a long, long struggle... I finally saw the light.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: From the ruins of Bolívar, to the prairies of Kazimierz, and finally here.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No normal person finds joy in the slaughter of others. Only idiotic pampered princelings derive any pleasure from seeing people bleed.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Now, you can save me, Infected, and I can help you dismantle the Armorless Union.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Sorry, but even if that's true, I'm not about to give you this.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're sick and tired of being manipulated.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Got it! Have a taste of this!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*... What's the meaning of this...?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley, run!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Running into the substructure? One wrong step, and you'll be mincemeat in the engine.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: There's nowhere for you to run––

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hngh.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley! Watch out!
A cyan arrow pierces Flametail Knight's armor.
Sona tries to block it, but the massive force of the impact sends her petite body flying.
Struggling in midair, she is launched into the gap between the city's plates.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona––!!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (Off the mark. Something blurred my vision for a second there...)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (An illusion caused by my fatigue...? No, something got in my way after all.)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You've lost your mind.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Tisk tisk, firing from such close range. Are you trying to get us both killed?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You... How dare you... do that to Sona!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'll admit, it was careless of me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I haven't had a chance to check if the chip is still intact. That's bad news, I wouldn't want that responsibility sitting on my shoulders.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Shut up, bastard!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (What to do, what to do. Hurry and kill Ashlock, and look for a way to go check the corpse?)

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: (No, this is far too dangerous. The power is about to come back on, and I wouldn't want to be caught between those plates.)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'll have you pay in blood––!!

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: So straightforward, so predictable. You've been all too easy to read since you lost your ability to think––

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Oh really?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hrmph. Was I the careless one?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: She's gone?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Was she only pretending to be enraged...?
Become a knight for the Infected.
Fight to the bitter end for the Infected.
That is my honor.
There is no greater honor... than to die for a glorious cause.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I would've liked to go out in a blaze of glory, but... what's going on now?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Roy is still around here somewhere. He'll discover my Arts sooner or later, so we mustn't tarry here.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Contact your companion and have her escape. I'll do what I can for her.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hey, Ashley, I'm fine.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Don't let him know, and look for a chance to escape. I slipped the chip into your pocket when I blocked that arrow for you. Go ahead and double-check.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No need to reply. See you on the way back.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You broke my fall? But how?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Arts can be applied in many different ways. After extensive studying, almost all Leithanians are able to use basic Arts, regardless of the nature of these Arts.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're the Candle Knight, right?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Why would a great knight like you... save an Infected like me?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: There's someone who wants to see you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: I can't tell you yet.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh... You should already know that we're pretty busy right now, paralyzing the city, attacking the K.G.C.C... I don't have time for a picnic, you know?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It's understandable that you would distrust me.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: No, I believe you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You can tell what someone's thinking, just gotta look into their eyes.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Of course, this trick doesn't work a hundred percent of the time, but this is desperate times, right?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ugh... What the hell is going on? The roads are blocked, and I can't get a taxi. Do I not get to go home tonight either?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: What an idiot... 'finish in one day' my ass... That report should've been done yesterday...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Wh—What... what's happening?!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Out of my way, or I'm shooting through all of you.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Eep! P-P-Please don't, I'm moving––

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Stop moving around, lad. You wouldn't want that noggin of yours finding a new home, eh?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: B-But she told me to move––

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Would you really trust someone who'd take your head off on a whim?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Toland, have you no shame hiding behind a civilian?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Aaaaagh—!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Good point. I'll count to three?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: P-P-P-please, I'm begging you, l-leave me alone!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: One.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Nooooooo––!!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Two.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Three!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: They're both insane! They're both insane––!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Where does this road lead–– Wait, over there, that's––

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Knight! Mr. Knight!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: I'm an employee of the Rose Paper Union! Please help me! You know who I am, right? I'll recommend you to the editorial department! There are two criminals over––

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Eek...!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Do you ever run out of arrows?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Grrr... This is the first time my prey's eluded me for several minutes... Not half bad, Toland Cash.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Is it your goal to stall me here?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Haha... What about you? Are you here to play with me?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: No, there's a handsome bounty on your head, and we're always in need of money.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Oh? Do you have a sickly little brother back home? Or maybe an elderly father who needs your support?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: This job brings more wealth than you can imagine, bounty hunter.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: We know the rules of this society better than you, better than any of the knights.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: We simply chose to take a little detour, and after tonight's hunt, we'll usher in a new beginning.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: But right now, it seems there's another idiot hellbent on messing things up.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: To think you could still see such a splend'rous night sky in this death-choked city.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This is the kind of night I've always known. Let this manmade malediction be left behind... and shed every last drop of this city's blood! Bravo, ye faceless rebels!

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: What a strange knight. The private duels must not be paying well.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Clown.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Is everyone okay?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret, I just found the spare battery... Alright, see, now the light's on, yeah? Doesn't feel like it'll last long though.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Looks like everyone's okay. V and Kowal went to check on the situation. They'll be back later.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Where's Młynar?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: He stayed home. Said it would be difficult to get away from work, and wanted some time alone.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: What about Shining and Nightingale?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: They were worried that the Armorless Union might have their sights on the Doctor, and rushed back to the Infected shelter.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Don't worry. They're both very dependable.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No, it's just that... I still don't know anything about the things going on around you.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Sorry, but I deliberately kept you out of the loop. I can't afford to get Doctor and the others tangled up with my personal affairs.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But maybe one day, you'll get to know each other. Maybe one day, Maria, you'll also find yourself aboard that ship.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Their dazzling idealism will eventually guide everyone forward. Even if they hold vastly different beliefs and walk different paths, nothing can shake the conviction in their hearts.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: That reminds me of...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The knights from the stories.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: I'm back!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It's pitch black... The flashlight merchant next door should've restocked by now, right?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh, it's Margaret.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It's an absolute mess outside right now. I say we behave ourselves, stay indoors, and wait for the power to come back.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Just sit here doing nothing? Wasn't there supposed to be a match today?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It was supposed to be the day the eight strongest knights were decided.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Have you seen the latest news of the Blood Knight?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: More or less... He's the undefeated king this season, from the qualifiers to the Major... But beyond that...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: He's also the hero of the Infected.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Where are we going? I'm not complaining, but I really don't exactly have a lot of free time on my hands.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: We're here.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: ...the Wall of Champions exhibit hall?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: This is a secret meeting, so try to keep your voice down.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So which knight wanted to meet me?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Knight...? Well, you're not technically wrong. She was indeed a respectable knight.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Haha, but don't be nervous... She's just a regular old lady now.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Head on in.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're not coming?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: Let's just say... she's one of the few people in Kazimierz who scares me even a bit.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Wow... Even the Candle Knight, bearer of the Candle Sword, is afraid of someone? What chance do I have then?

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: It probably won't be the same for you.

steps.name: The Candle Knight
steps.text: After all, she counts as my half adoptive mother, at least in name.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (It's the same emergency power supply as the K.G.C.C... Was this place not affected by the outage either?)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Both the knights... and the General Chamber...)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (...are still shining through the darkness.)
The lights flicker.
And so does Sona's train of thought.
The knights, and the money, were able to avoid the deep night.
Who drowns in the darkness?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Flametail Knight... Sona.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Come here and let me have a closer look at you.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You! You're...!

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Now, now. I didn't come here today to talk business.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: I heard... the Infected knights made some kind of deal with the knights of the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Between the Knights Association and Demian, a member of the Adeptus.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: In order for the Infected to survive in the Grand Knight Territory, they agreed to participate in this operation with his cooperation.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: The Great Kawalerielki Separation... the Adeptus gave in, letting it happen once more.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Look at this wall... These knights were supposed to become real heroes. Not... this, symbols for spectators to gawk at.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Does this sight not fill you with great sorrow?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It certainly does, ma'am.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But I feel more sorrow for... the Infected who still need equal treatment, and for those totally lost to entertainment and materialism.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I cry... for each and every person struggling to make it to the next sunrise here in Kazimierz.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Truly a spectacular inaugural speech, young squirrel.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi really give us a normal life?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Paperwork, procedures, any documentation the National Council needs. Of course, the Adeptus will handle it all for you. That is what Demian promised you.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: But what about the Originium crystals on your body?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: I admire Pinus Sylvestris, but the problems you must overcome... are not so well-defined.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: In time, Demian will reach out to you. He may not be the sharpest tool in the shed, but trust him. He has his ways.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Good. My knightclub will be here shortly, so hurry and find your companions.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Also, tell Viviana to come and have a meal with me when she's not busy.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: .........Ma'am, what does it mean to be a knight?

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: The answer to the question is different for everyone, child.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: You wouldn't be interested in mine anyway. Us old folks, we've seen too much.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: Go, little squirrel, go.

steps.name: An Aged Knight
steps.text: See if the sunrise in Kazimierz still blazes ever-bright.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: ...I lost her.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Would it be more efficient to post a surround and suppress mission later?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I'm here. What's the matter?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What...? How many?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Exceptional swordsmanship.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Ahh, I'd prefer not to waste any more time here with you, old friend.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Goddamned maniac...

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'd best get out of here after I kill Toland.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I'm in a game of hide-and-seek with the 'Guildmaster' and a Nightzmora. Not the best time to chat.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: No... I'll head there now.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Let's wrap up our little game, Toland.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: You're running?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Same goes for you, Nightzmora.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: What? You're a Nightzmora?!

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Let's call it here for now.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: You came to Kawalerielki to find your people and a good fight, right?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Don't speak so lightly of our tradition of glory, Kazimierzian. You don't have that right.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: No, I'm just offering you a warning, Nightzmora, out of the kindness of my heart.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Don't waste your energy on us.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I can agree with that.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Boastful nonsense.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hmph. See you never, dumbass.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Is the traffic still stuck? I heard the power's already come back in some places.

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: Shouldn't the Knights Association compensate us for our terrible losses?!

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: Yeah! The government should pay us back our travel expenses!

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ugh... I hope the meat in the fridge didn't go bad.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You know, we can take out any single one of their people, alone.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Two of them, we'll need to bring help.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Three of them, and it's going to be one hell of a rough battle.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If there's three or more of them... that could take a full tactical squad, and the Armorless Union can't afford those losses.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: If there's more of them than you can count on your fingers, calling in the entire Armorless Union might not even be enough to put them down.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: I know, I've seen them before. Your concern is better placed elsewhere.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: So, how many did the scouts see?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Roughly forty.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Well shit... Right at this juncture?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Yes. I've already notified the Board of Directors.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Do they intend to capture the Kawalerielki Alliance?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Impossible!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: No, this can't be! Where are the military consultants? Where are the people monitoring the knights?!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Those campaign knights dispatched by the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi... Where were they in the last report?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Five hundred and seventy-three kilometers.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: There's no way a normal squad of campaign knights would be able to march that fast... It's impossible...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Did the Adeptus mobilize another branch behind the General Chamber's back? No, that can't be...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Silverlance fast-response squad... What's their fastest record?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Could they have disguised their military identification code? And even their armor and lances?

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: Hm? It's a little brighter now, isn't it?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Look over there! That little halo of light on the other side of the road! The power must've come back over there!

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: But... the lights still won't turn on...

steps.name: A Tourist
steps.text: That looks a lot more like... moonlight?
Moonlight.
The prosperity afforded by the advent of the energized glass tubes gradually led to modern man forgetting the appearance of the primordial moonlight.
This city, engulfed in a brief moment of darkness––
––is illuminated by a silver glow.

steps.name: An Onlooker
steps.text: Are..... are those knights over there?

steps.name: A Kazimierz Knight
steps.text: Th-The campaign knights?! Here?!
The knights pass through the crowd.
Through the city known as the City of Knights.
Through the city that does not recognize them.
Through the city that they do not recognize.
They came from a faraway fortress close to the border.
Their bodies are stained with the clear and tangible scent of the soil.
A scent mixed with flesh, blood, bones, and the lives of countless heroes buried on battlefields past.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Inform all members of the Armorless Union to stop whatever they're doing this instant, no matter what it is.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Do not make any moves unless you want trouble. Do not act rashly.

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Monique?

steps.name: Monique
steps.text: That one... over there...

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Nostalgic?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: ...I certainly am.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: I miss... that time when I stupidly thought this place wasn't so bad. Those were good times. Exciting times.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: If you had really given up, then you wouldn't still be here, would you?

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: Młynar, take a good look all around you. The city sleeps, and nobody has ever even woken up.

steps.name: Toland
steps.text: But what about you?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Reporting! A portion of the communications lines are back––!

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ––Connect me to the associate justice of the National Council.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yessir.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Your honor?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You already know what I'm about to say. This band of campaign knights trespassed into the Grand Knight Territory without authorization, violating the Second Act––

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Former Associate Justice Duke of the National Council, has been detained on suspicion of bribery, smuggling, murder, and dereliction of duty.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: I would advise you to choose your words calmly and carefully, Spokesman.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: The Grand Knight Territory is in a state of emergency due to a blackout, and the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi has the authority to send troops into the city during a state of emergency.

steps.name: A Voice from the Phone
steps.text: Do you have any further questions?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: None. I apologize for the intrusion, sir.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Communications are more or less restored, Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Look how busy they are over there... What do you think a phone is?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Huh? Obviously a communication tool...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: No. The phone is the spindle and plough of modern society, the pathway that weaves the fabric of life as we currently know it.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It is a symbol of greatness, Mr. McKee.
McKee's words fail him.
Suddenly, he senses an aura of sorts from Malkiewicz.
Over the last few months, a business venture failed spectacularly, amounting to nothing. Those who have been whipped almost naturally give off a certain kind of aura.
He has seen this kind of aura in many people before.
Most of them were chewed up and mangled by the changing times or by the competition. As for the few who survived––
––nearly all of them turned out the same.
